newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan orders air force transport planes to Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Japan orders air force transport planes to Thailand.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Friday ordered Japanese air force transport planes to fly to a base in Thailand in preparation for an evacuation operation from Cambodia, the top government spokesman said.

"This is a precautionary measure and does not mean that the situation in Cambodia has changed," Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference. "The planes will leave Okinawa as soon as preparations are complete."

Three C-130 transport planes of Japan's Air Self-Defence Force, or air force, have been on standby for the past two days in Japan's southernmost island of Okinawa waiting for orders to fly to the area.
Dozens of Japanese have fled Cambodia since a Japanese engineer was killed by a stray shell last weekend in fighting between Cambodia's rival factions.
